links.outcome: Response similarity to reference answers (BLEU, Jaccard, BERTScore) for GraphRAG-grounded LLM versus ungrounded LLMs
links.effect: GraphRAG local LLM scored BLEU 0.99, Jaccard 0.98, BERTScore 0.98, outperforming ChatGPT, Claude and BioMistral on simulated clinical and layperson prompts.
links.quote: It achieved a bilingual evaluation understudy score of 0.99, Jaccard similarity of 0.98, and BERTScore of 0.98, outperforming the benchmark LLMs.

unlisted_practices: Deploying local (on-premise) LLMs to give resource-constrained settings access to medical evidence

screen.reason: Evaluates whether adding knowledge-graph retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) to an LLM improves the factual accuracy and relevance of clinical decision support for gestational diabetes compared to baseline models.
